BrochureContent.Content:
Make the right move with your #1 Agency!

Situated in a highly sought-after residential location along the ever-popular Beamore Road, Malfbern, Drogheda, Co. Meath, A92 T954 is an impressive four-bedroom detached bungalow residence occupying a mature private site with the added benefit of both attached and detached garages.

Originally constructed circa 1977, this fine family home offers spacious and well-proportioned accommodation throughout and presents an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a substantial detached residence in a prime and convenient setting close to Drogheda town centre and all local amenities.

The property is approached via a private driveway with ample off-street parking and enjoys mature surrounding gardens offering excellent outdoor space. Internally, the accommodation briefly comprises entrance hallway, spacious sitting room, kitchen/dining area, living room, four bedrooms (master en-suite) and family bathroom together with additional storage, utility and WC.

A notable feature of the property is the inclusion of both an attached garage and a separate detached garage/workshop, offering excellent potential for a wide variety of uses including storage, hobby space, home office conversion or further development potential, subject to the necessary planning permission.

The location is second to none, positioned within easy reach of Drogheda town centre, schools, shops, sporting facilities, train station and the M1 motorway corridor, providing excellent connectivity to both Dublin and Belfast alike.

Overall, Malfbern represents a rare opportunity to acquire a mature detached bungalow on a generous site in one of Drogheda’s most established and desirable residential locations.
